details.youth_clubs: Fulham FC (2006-2012), Gillingham FC (2012-2014), Welling United (2014-2015), Maidenhead United (2015-2016)
details.further_information: Parents are from Ukraine and Russia. He has 25 caps for the England national futsal team. Maidenhead received £4m from having inserted a 10% sell-on clause in the contract when Kilman was sold to Wolverhampton Wanderers in 2018.
